record.question: Who is the incumbent Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports?
record.explanation: Answer D: Kiren Rijiju. Kiren Rijiju was Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Youth Affairs and Sports in the Modi 2.0 Council of Ministers. Reference: https://www.pmindia.gov.in/en/assets-and-liabilities-of-the-union-council-of-ministers-2018-2019-as-on-30-03-2019/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
